purpose: Model-free lexical QMD collections. Single source of truth for scripts/search_lexical.py, configure-search.(sh|ps1) and refresh-search.(sh|ps1). Every collection is rooted at the repository root and selects files by mask, so a result path is always repository-relative. A mask that matches nothing is valid (the numbered layers appear only when material arrives).

collections.name: wiki
collections.context: Canonical records: objects, notes, claims, relations. Interpretive questions start here.

collections.name: wiki-source-records
collections.context: Provenance records pointing to immutable originals. Use for where-does-this-come-from questions.

collections.name: wiki-derivatives
collections.context: Machine-extracted text of originals. Candidate passages only; open the original for exact form.

collections.name: wiki-captures
collections.context: Noncanonical intake captures. Never canonical evidence.

model_free.query_rule: qmd query is allowed only as a typed document whose every line is 'lex:' and only with --no-rerank; bare (expand) queries load a query-expansion model.
